scope:

measure propagation/amplification; these errors are not additive components.
finding: For accepted full shape captures, CPU execution of the original head on actual TT hidden values has 6.77% error vs the stock prediction; observed TT prediction error is 6.69%. The learned projection amplifies upstream differences; a separate output-head precision fix is low priority on this fixture. These metrics are not additive error components.
controls: Physical checkpoint and all source artifact SHA256 values verified. Original FP32 and pipeline-precision CPU head outputs reconstruct saved full-model predictions bitwise. Source TT capture equals ordinary full-model final output bitwise and repeats exactly. No new device lowering or kernels were introduced.
decision: Prioritize attention/torso accuracy and performance experiments; preserve full-trajectory checks. This diagnosis concerns one shape forward and does not establish the same attribution for occupancy or other scenes.
retention: Full selected hidden states, observed predictions and teacher-forced CPU predictions retained, along with source/checkpoint/script hashes. Full original 32-state capture is reproducible via block_diagnostic.py.
